        "contents": "# Smart Bottom Menu with Assistant UI Integration\n\nThis directory contains the implementation of the MindMap bottom menu with AI assistance capabilities through the Assistant UI framework.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe bottom menu serves as the primary interface for users to interact with the mindmap. It provides commands for:\n\n- Searching entity databases\n- Chatting with the AI assistant\n- Analyzing connections\n- Exploring related entities\n- Deep research capabilities\n\n## Smart Bottom Menu Implementation\n\nThe &#96;SmartBottomMenu&#96; component enhances the standard &#96;MindMapBottomMenu&#96; with AI capabilities:\n\n1. **Context Awareness**: Provides real-time state information to the AI assistant\n2. **Function Calling**: Allows the AI to directly manipulate the menu state and perform actions\n3. **Intelligent Command Execution**: Enables natural language processing of user requests\n\n## Usage\n\nTo use the AI-enhanced bottom menu in your application:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use client'\n\nimport { MindMapProvider } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { SmartBottomMenu } from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu'\nimport { AssistantProvider } from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport default function MindmapPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cAssistantProvider\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapProvider\u003e\n        {/* Your graph component */}\n        \u003cSmartBottomMenu /\u003e\n      \u003c/MindMapProvider\u003e\n    \u003c/AssistantProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available AI Functions\n\nThe Smart Bottom Menu provides these functions to the AI assistant:\n\n| Function | Description | Parameters |\n|----------|-------------|------------|\n| &#96;executeCommand&#96; | Activates a command mode | &#96;commandId: string&#96; |\n| &#96;selectEntityType&#96; | Selects an entity type | &#96;entityType: string&#96; |\n| &#96;createSearchNode&#96; | Creates a search node | &#96;searchTerm: string, entityType?: string&#96; |\n| &#96;addInsightToNode&#96; | Adds AI insight to a node | &#96;nodeId: string, insight: string&#96; |\n\n## Example Interactions\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nUser: \"Search for UFO sightings in 1964\"\n",

A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap bottom menu\n * by providing custom context and function calling to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartBottomMenu() {\n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Access MindMap context\n  const {\n    nodes,\n    edges,\n    activeNode,\n    addUserInputNode,\n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    updateNodeData,\n    getNodes,\n    getNode,\n    setNodes,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  // Track active command and model selection states to provide as context\n  const [activeCommand, setActiveCommand] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Get AI session status\n  const sessionState = useAssistant({\n    api: '/api/disclosure/chat',\n  })\n\n  // Add AI integration capabilities\n  const {loadRecordsWithAI, isAIEnabled} = useAIMindMap()\n  const {calculateCenterOfScreen, getNextId} = useMindMap()\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available commands\n  const getAvailableCommands = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return COMMANDS.map((cmd) =\u003e ({\n      id: cmd.id,\n      label: cmd.label,\n      description: cmd.description,\n      prefix: cmd.prefix,\n    }))\n  }, [])\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available entity types\n  const getAvailableEntityTypes = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return ENTITY_TYPES.map((entity) =\u003e ({\n      type: entity.type,\n      displayName: entity.displayName,\n      description: entity.description,\n    }))\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "# Canvas Menu Component\n\nA beautiful, modern floating command palette for the Ultraterrestrial mindmap interface, inspired by CommandK design patterns.\n\n## Features\n\n- 🎨 **Glassmorphic Design** - Beautiful backdrop blur effects with subtle animations\n- ⌨️ **Keyboard First** - Full keyboard navigation with Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut\n- 🔍 **Smart Search** - Real-time filtering of commands with highlighting\n- 💬 **AI Integration** - Built-in chat interface with AI assistant\n- 🎯 **Entity Management** - Quick access to add entities to the mindmap\n- 🗺️ **Tour Controls** - Guided and free exploration modes\n- ✨ **Smooth Animations** - Framer Motion powered transitions\n- 📱 **Responsive** - Works on all screen sizes\n\n## Usage\n\n### Basic Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { CanvasMenu } from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/canvas-menu'\n\nfunction MyComponent() {\n  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)\n  \n  const handleAction = (action: MenuAction) =\u003e {\n    console.log('Action triggered:', action)\n    // Handle the action based on type\n    switch (action.type) {\n      case 'chat':\n        // Handle chat action\n        break\n      case 'add-entity':\n        // Handle entity addition\n        break\n      // ... other cases\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCanvasMenu\n      isOpen={isOpen}\n      onClose={() =\u003e setIsOpen(false)}\n      onAction={handleAction}\n    /\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Positioning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cCanvasMenu\n  position={{ x: 400, y: 300 }}\n  isOpen={isOpen}\n  onClose={() =\u003e setIsOpen(false)}\n  onAction={handleAction}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With Custom Trigger\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cCanvasMenu\n  className=\"bottom-8 right-8\" // Position the trigger button\n  onAction={handleAction}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Props\n\n| Prop | Type | Default | Description |\n|------|------|---------|-------------|\n| &#96;position&#96; | &#96;{ x: number, y: number }&#96; | Center of screen | Position of the menu when open |\n| &#96;isOpen&#96; | &#96;boolean&#96; | &#96;false&#96; | Controlled open state |\n| &#96;onClose&#96; | &#96;() =\u003e void&#96; | - | Callback when menu is closed |\n",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className='vercel'\u003e\n      \u003cCommand\n        ref={ref}\n        onKeyDown={(e: React.KeyboardEvent) =\u003e {\n          if (e.key === 'Enter') {\n            bounce()\n          }\n\n          if (isHome || inputValue.length) {\n            return\n          }\n\n          if (e.key === 'Backspace') {\n            e.preventDefault()\n            popPage()\n            bounce()\n          }\n        }}\n      \u003e\n        \u003cdiv\u003e\n          {pages.map((p) =\u003e (\n            \u003cdiv key={p} cmdk-vercel-badge=''\u003e\n              {p}\n            \u003c/div\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cCommand.Input\n          autoFocus\n          placeholder='What do you need?'\n          onValueChange={(value) =\u003e {\n            setInputValue(value)\n          }}\n        /\u003e\n        \u003cCommand.List\u003e\n          \u003cCommand.Empty\u003eNo results found.\u003c/Command.Empty\u003e\n          {activePage === 'home' \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cSearchEntities\n              searchProjects={() =\u003e setPages([...pages, 'projects'])}\n            /\u003e\n          )}\n          {activePage === 'projects' \u0026\u0026 \u003cProjects /\u003e}\n        \u003c/Command.List\u003e\n      \u003c/Command\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "# Canvas Menu Component\n\nA beautiful, modern floating command palette for the Ultraterrestrial mindmap interface, inspired by CommandK design patterns.\n\n## Features\n\n- 🎨 **Glassmorphic Design** - Beautiful backdrop blur effects with subtle animations\n- ⌨️ **Keyboard First** - Full keyboard navigation with Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut\n- 🔍 **Smart Search** - Real-time filtering of commands with highlighting\n- 💬 **AI Integration** - Built-in chat interface with AI assistant\n- 🎯 **Entity Management** - Quick access to add entities to the mindmap\n- 🗺️ **Tour Controls** - Guided and free exploration modes\n- ✨ **Smooth Animations** - Framer Motion powered transitions\n- 📱 **Responsive** - Works on all screen sizes\n\n## Usage\n\n### Basic Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { CanvasMenu } from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/canvas-menu'\n\nfunction MyComponent() {\n  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)\n  \n  const handleAction = (action: MenuAction) =\u003e {\n    console.log('Action triggered:', action)\n    // Handle the action based on type\n    switch (action.type) {\n      case 'chat':\n        // Handle chat action\n        break\n      case 'add-entity':\n        // Handle entity addition\n        break\n      // ... other cases\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cCanvasMenu\n      isOpen={isOpen}\n      onClose={() =\u003e setIsOpen(false)}\n      onAction={handleAction}\n    /\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Custom Positioning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cCanvasMenu\n  position={{ x: 400, y: 300 }}\n  isOpen={isOpen}\n  onClose={() =\u003e setIsOpen(false)}\n  onAction={handleAction}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With Custom Trigger\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n\u003cCanvasMenu\n  className=\"bottom-8 right-8\" // Position the trigger button\n  onAction={handleAction}\n/\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Props\n\n| Prop | Type | Default | Description |\n|------|------|---------|-------------|\n| &#96;position&#96; | &#96;{ x: number, y: number }&#96; | Center of screen | Position of the menu when open |\n| &#96;isOpen&#96; | &#96;boolean&#96; | &#96;false&#96; | Controlled open state |\n| &#96;onClose&#96; | &#96;() =\u003e void&#96; | - | Callback when menu is closed |\n",

        "contents": "\n\n// Command Item Component\nconst CommandItem = ({\n  command,\n  isActive,\n  onClick,\n  searchQuery,\n}: {\n  command: Command\n  isActive: boolean\n  onClick: () =\u003e void\n  searchQuery: string\n}) =\u003e {\n  const highlightMatch = (text: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!searchQuery) return text\n    const regex = new RegExp(&#96;(${searchQuery})&#96;, 'gi')\n    const parts = text.split(regex)\n    return parts.map((part, i) =\u003e\n      regex.test(part) ? (\n        \u003cspan key={i} className='text-cyan-400'\u003e\n          {part}\n        \u003c/span\u003e\n      ) : (\n        part\n      )\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cmotion.div\n      initial={false}\n      animate={{\n        opacity: isActive ? 1 : 0,\n        height: isActive ? 36 : 0,\n      }}\n      transition={{\n        duration: 0.35,\n        ease: [0.6, 0.6, 0, 1],\n      }}\n      className={cn(\n        'px-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-white/75 text-xs rounded-lg cursor-pointer',\n        'hover:bg-white/[0.06] active:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors',\n        !isActive \u0026\u0026 'pointer-events-none overflow-hidden'\n      )}\n      onClick={onClick}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className='w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center text-white/50'\u003e{command.icon}\u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className='flex-1'\u003e{highlightMatch(command.name)}\u003c/div\u003e\n      {command.description \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003cdiv className='text-[10px] text-white/30'\u003e{command.description}\u003c/div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/motion.div\u003e\n  )\n}",
